travels_with_the_interior: every light below (SYNC.md 6); sky / sun / moon / fog / exposure stay per level

level_scale.derivation: DojoLab stage 3 (2026-10-01, measured): both levels use manual exposure without the physical camera, so a pixel is L x 2^bias. ArmoryLab PostProcess_Armory bias -2.68 (its level.json); DojoLab PostProcess_Dojo bias +1.20 (look_r3 ENV exposure, the UDS sunset; showcase level.json). Parity = 2^(-2.68 - 1.20) = 0.06792 for the lights' ue_armorylab_night candela and the emissive instances (DojoLab child MIs MI_DJA_*). The survey's starting value 10.295 used the analytic -6.04 EV, not the exposure the PPV runs at: replaced. Per-level only (SYNC.md 6): DojoLab also sets per-role attenuation radii for perf (Scripts/dojo/unreal/dj_armory_look.py), recorded in BUILD_NOTES.
